content.title: Multi-Agent Entry Relay | Independent Proofs, Synchronized Finish
content.summary: Hold one central challenge spatially stable while different team members enter along separate routes and complete distinct proof actions. Overlap their paths only after every role is readable, then finish with synchronized commitment instead of an unstructured group fight.

quick_start.input_format: Fixed central challenge + at least 3 characters/systems + independent entrance routes and responsibilities + delayed high-level routes + synchronous closure
quick_start.recommended_input: Three original greenhouse service machines handle the same knot from the ground, glass wall and above; each route first proves its responsibility independently, and finally pulls, stabilizes, cools and completes storage simultaneously.
required_anchors: Establish one spatially persistent challenge field and the full team before any individual entry.
Give the first participant one complete entry path and proof action.
Delay the most displaced entry until earlier roles are readable.
End with synchronized commitment while preserving each participant's route identity.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Hold one central challenge spatially stable while different team members enter along separate routes and complete distinct proof actions. Overlap their paths only after every role is readable, then finish with synchronized commitment instead of an unstructured group fight.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one persistent central threat geometry and a team outside it, then give distinct team members separate entry arcs and proof actions while the threat remains spatially stable. Escalate from single entries to overlapping paths only after each role is readable, and end with a synchronized multi-agent commitment rather than an unstructured melee.

invariants.rule: Establish one spatially persistent challenge field and the full team before any individual entry.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening on a close strike hides team geography.

invariants.rule: Give the first participant one complete entry path and proof action.
invariants.ablation_failure: Several simultaneous first actions create noise.

invariants.rule: Give a second participant a materially different route or action responsibility against the same field.
invariants.ablation_failure: A repeated route is only a costume swap.

invariants.rule: Delay the most displaced entry until earlier roles are readable.
invariants.purpose: Creates a visible escalation in route geometry.
invariants.ablation_failure: An early overhead entry spends the strongest spatial change too soon.

invariants.rule: End with synchronized commitment while preserving each participant's route identity.
invariants.purpose: Converts separate proofs into coordinated payoff.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unstructured crowd obscures who contributes what.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: source tatami room and tentacled white antagonist
source swords, uniforms and colored slash arcs

instantiations.concept: Three greenhouse service drones surround one invasive root knot: a ground cutter opens the first channel, a wall crawler clamps a side branch, an overhead pollination drone drops a cold seal, and all three synchronize one final extraction while retaining separate paths.
